programme_facts.value: To receive your I-20, you must submit I-20 delivery option, financial guarantee form, financial document (bank statement or financial support letter), foreign SEVIS address, copy of passport, and SEVIS transfer form (if applicable).
If you are residing in the U.S. on a valid visa, you will need to provide proof of your current visa.

It is extremely important that you submit the documents required for the issuance of your I-20 to us. Upload the required documents through My ASU. The upload tool on My ASU only allows the upload of each document type once, so please ensure you have all your documents ready before uploading.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: If you upload financial documents that do not cover the full funding needed as shown on the financial guarantee, you will be asked to submit additional documentation to demonstrate the full funding, which will delay the issuance of your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Once ASU has received all documents required to issue an I-20 and has verified that they are complete, you will receive an email with a link to download your I-20 from the Document Portal in My ASU.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: You will not receive a physical I-20 via mail.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: The email will be sent to your non-ASU personal email address. Be sure to check it often, including junk and spam folders, so you do not miss any messages.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Once you have received your I-20, be sure to pay your I-901 fee. Once the fee has been paid do not delay in contacting your consulate to obtain a visa appointment.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: If you are unable to submit the documentation needed to receive an I-20 from ASU or are unable to obtain your F1 visa in time to arrive by the start of the semester of your admission, contact [international_admissions@asu.edu](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#4c0d1f19252238293e222d382523222d200c2d3f3962292839) and we can advise you on your options.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: If you have any questions, please contact our International Admission Services team. We will work with you to keep you on track.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: View the I-20 Frequently Asked Questions webpage for more information.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Be sure to check wait times for your local embassy or consulate, as some areas may be experiencing wait times longer than 30 days.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: You can now apply for your visa up to 365 days before the start date listed on your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Complete these steps as soon as possible so that when your local embassy can take your appointment, you will be ready to proceed with your next steps.
